address: 1288 Dundas St. W., Toronto, M6J 1X7, Canada
bio: A home away from home, this venerable Roman favorite recently celebrated its 10-year anniversary with a quick renovation that has paid off handsomely. The restaurant is as inviting as they come, radiating comfort and anchored by a marble bar that welcomes solo diners like long- lost friends. From bread to charcuterie, practically everything is made in-house here, down to the fantastic pastas that make up the very heart of this menu. There isn’t a table in sight that hasn’t ordered either the signature cacio e pepe or the bucatini all’Amatriciana. Comforting starters like golden-fried arancini stuffed with mozzarella di bufula or clever riffs like caprese sformato reflect the many talents of this capable kitchen, which also offers a tasting menu....
